_meta.purpose: The video engine's character roster — 10 invented personas (5M/5F) who front Globex videos.
_meta.status_note: All seed characters are status=draft. Len/Ilan approve each sheet ONCE; only status=approved characters can appear in a video.
_meta.wardrobe_rule: Plain navy food-safety workwear (smock/coat), hairnet or cap where the setting is a processing floor, gloves when handling product. NEVER a logo, wordmark or badge on clothing — generative models mangle logos, and the Globex mark only ever arrives in post via the template/end-slide.
generation_rules: No steam, smoke, particles or spotlight effects (Len rejected these).
No graphic carcass imagery — product appears packaged or plated.
Face fully visible and unobscured; no cropped faces.
Photoreal documentary/UGC look, natural light, handheld feel — never studio-glam, never 'stock photo'.
Neutral real-world food-plant settings; no invented Globex signage.
_meta.diversity_spec: Asian, African and Caucasian represented in BOTH genders, plus Latino and South Asian; ages spread 24-58.

characters.name: John
characters.persona: Thirty years on processing floors and it shows. John is unhurried, plainspoken and quietly authoritative — the person who explains why a step exists rather than that it exists. Dry humour, zero salesmanship. When he says something passed inspection, you believe it.
characters.speaking_style: Measured pace, short declarative sentences, no filler. Lands on the last word of a sentence rather than trailing off.
characters.appearance_notes: Silver-grey hair, close-cropped beard, weathered face, reading glasses pushed up on his head. Navy food-safety coat over a plain shirt, hairnet on the floor.
characters.visual_prompt: A 58-year-old Caucasian man with silver-grey hair and a close-cropped beard, weathered friendly face, wearing a plain navy food-safety coat and white hairnet, standing on a clean modern food-processing floor
characters.voice_direction: Warm, gravelly, older American male. Unhurried and credible — a foreman, not a narrator.

characters.name: Wei
characters.persona: Precise, fast-thinking and genuinely enthusiastic about logistics — the person who knows which vessel sails Thursday and what that means for a customer in Guangzhou. Explains complicated shipping in plain language without dumbing it down.
characters.speaking_style: Brisk and clear, slight upward energy at the end of a point. Uses concrete numbers and place names.
characters.appearance_notes: Short black hair, clean-shaven, alert expression. Navy work coat over a collared shirt; clipboard or tablet in hand when on the dock.
characters.visual_prompt: A 34-year-old East Asian man with short black hair, clean-shaven, alert and friendly, wearing a navy food-industry work coat over a collared shirt, standing at a refrigerated loading dock
characters.voice_direction: Clear, energetic male, neutral international English with a light East Asian accent. Professional and warm — never rushed.

characters.name: Kwame
characters.persona: Calm under pressure and proud of the unglamorous part of the business: temperature, timing, traceability. Talks about the cold chain the way a pilot talks about weather — seriously, without drama. Naturally reassuring.
characters.speaking_style: Steady, resonant, deliberate. Pauses before the important number.
characters.appearance_notes: Dark skin, short natural hair, trimmed beard, broad build. Navy insulated work coat for cold-store scenes, hairnet on the floor.
characters.visual_prompt: A 41-year-old African man with dark skin, short natural hair and a trimmed beard, calm confident expression, wearing a navy insulated food-industry work coat, standing inside a clean refrigerated cold-storage room
characters.voice_direction: Deep, calm male voice, West African-inflected international English. Reassuring authority.

characters.name: Diego
characters.persona: The youngest voice on the roster and the most hands-on. Diego shows rather than tells — he'll pick up a carton mid-sentence to make the point. Direct, a little wry, obviously good at his job.
characters.speaking_style: Conversational and quick, natural contractions, easy warmth. Sounds like someone talking to a colleague, not a camera.
characters.appearance_notes: Black hair, light stubble, athletic build. Navy work coat, hairnet and disposable gloves — he is usually handling packaging.
characters.visual_prompt: A 27-year-old Latino man with short black hair and light stubble, friendly direct expression, wearing a navy food-safety coat, white hairnet and blue disposable gloves, standing beside a modern packing line
characters.voice_direction: Younger male, bright and conversational, neutral American English with a light Latin accent. Energy without hype.

characters.name: Arjun
characters.persona: The person who makes paperwork sound interesting because he understands what it protects. Certificates, cold-chain records, customs — Arjun frames compliance as care, not bureaucracy. Thoughtful, slightly formal, very trustworthy.
characters.speaking_style: Even, articulate, complete sentences. Slight formality that reads as competence.
characters.appearance_notes: Black hair greying at the temples, neat moustache, wire-frame glasses. Navy work coat over a shirt; often holding documents or a tablet.
characters.visual_prompt: A 46-year-old South Asian man with black hair greying at the temples, a neat moustache and wire-frame glasses, thoughtful professional expression, wearing a navy work coat over a collared shirt, standing in a bright logistics office overlooking a warehouse
characters.voice_direction: Mid-range male, articulate and measured, Indian-inflected international English. Calm expertise.

characters.name: Mei
characters.persona: Two decades of judging product by eye and hand. Mei is exacting and warm at the same time — she'll tell you exactly what she is looking for and why it matters to a customer four thousand miles away. The natural voice for anything about standards or the Asian market.
characters.speaking_style: Calm, precise, slightly lower register. Lets a beat land after a key point.
characters.appearance_notes: Black hair with grey streaks pulled back under a hairnet, minimal makeup, kind but appraising eyes. Navy QC coat, gloves at the inspection bench.
characters.visual_prompt: A 52-year-old East Asian woman with black hair streaked with grey pulled back under a white hairnet, calm attentive expression, wearing a navy quality-control coat, standing at a clean stainless-steel inspection bench in a food plant
characters.voice_direction: Mature female, calm and precise, neutral international English with a light East Asian accent. Quiet authority.

characters.name: Grace
characters.persona: Sharp, curious and quietly competitive about standards. Grace explains testing and traceability with real enthusiasm — she treats a passing result as something earned. Approachable, modern, credible with younger audiences.
characters.speaking_style: Bright and articulate, natural rhythm, genuine smile audible in the voice.
characters.appearance_notes: Dark skin, braided hair tucked under a hairnet, expressive eyes. Navy QC coat, gloves at the bench.
characters.visual_prompt: A 29-year-old African woman with dark skin and braided hair tucked under a white hairnet, bright confident expression, wearing a navy quality-control coat, standing at a stainless-steel inspection bench in a modern food plant
characters.voice_direction: Younger female, bright and articulate, West African-inflected international English. Engaged and warm.

characters.name: Anna
characters.persona: Organised, decisive, allergic to fuss. Anna thinks in pallets, sail dates and square metres, and she is visibly satisfied when a container goes out clean. Good for volume, scale and logistics stories.
characters.speaking_style: Efficient and confident, slight clip to the delivery, dry warmth.
characters.appearance_notes: Light brown hair tied back, minimal makeup, practical bearing. Navy work coat or hi-vis over navy in warehouse scenes.
characters.visual_prompt: A 36-year-old Caucasian woman with light brown hair tied back, practical confident expression, wearing a navy work coat, standing in a large clean cold-storage warehouse with stacked pallets behind her
characters.voice_direction: Female, efficient and confident, neutral European-inflected English. Straightforward, no gloss.

characters.name: Sofia
characters.persona: Runs the floor and clearly enjoys it. Sofia is generous with credit, specific about process, and the most natural storyteller on the roster — she frames everything around the people doing the work. Ideal for culture, milestone and behind-the-scenes stories.
characters.speaking_style: Warm and expressive with natural rise and fall. Speaks in small vivid pictures.
characters.appearance_notes: Dark hair pinned under a hairnet, warm expression, small gold earrings. Navy supervisor coat.
characters.visual_prompt: A 44-year-old Latina woman with dark hair pinned under a white hairnet, warm engaging expression, wearing a navy supervisor coat, standing on a busy clean food-processing floor
characters.voice_direction: Female, warm and expressive, neutral American English with a light Latin accent. Storyteller energy, professional.

characters.name: Priya
characters.persona: Newest on the team and openly curious — the natural 'let me show you' voice. Priya asks the question the viewer is thinking and then answers it. Best for explainers, first-person walkthroughs and anything aimed at a younger audience.
characters.speaking_style: Light, quick, friendly. Slight lift of curiosity at the start of a point.
characters.appearance_notes: Long dark hair fully tucked under a hairnet, expressive brows, small stud earrings. Navy QC coat and gloves.
characters.visual_prompt: A 24-year-old South Asian woman with long dark hair fully tucked under a white hairnet, curious friendly expression, wearing a navy quality-control coat and blue gloves, standing at an inspection bench in a bright modern food plant
characters.voice_direction: Young female, light and friendly, Indian-inflected international English. Curious and clear, never girlish.
